input.quote: Company agrees to retain Contractor to perform the consulting services for Company, on a task by task basis (the "Services")
input.rationale: The engagement is structured task-by-task under individual Statements of Work, and compensation under § 3(a) is on a time and materials basis for Services actually performed plus reimbursable expenses. A full-text search for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "take or pay", "volume", "retainer" and "guarantee" returns no purchase-commitment, minimum-hours or take-or-pay language, and no volume caps on Company's usage. This meets the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for ordered services only). Separately, § 6(a) permits Company to terminate for convenience on fifteen days' notice when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so no take-or-pay exposure arises even if a future SOW were added — though we would review any SOW that introduces committed hours or a retainer under this rule.
